candidate_relations.reason: The nonkeratinizing squamous lining with mucin-containing goblet cells supports exophytic Schneiderian papilloma. “Squamous cell papilloma” is broader and can also denote a distinct vestibular cutaneous papilloma, so it does not fully preserve the required Schneiderian subtype.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Papilloma at the correct site, but lacks explicit exophytic Schneiderian subtype/lineage.
